steps.narration: Today we're looking at repair and reformulation — what to do when you hear yourself making a mistake mid-sentence, instead of just pushing through it.

spans.text: Goal: notice when a sentence is breaking down mid-way, and restart it cleanly instead of pushing through the error.

items.definition: Noticing a sentence is breaking down and fixing it while you're still speaking.
Restarting the same idea in a cleaner, simpler way instead of abandoning it.

steps.narration: Here's how the framework we calibrate against describes this skill formally.
Compare these two ways of recovering from the same stumble.
